place: Kamas Valley, UT 84036 — Peoa, Oakley, Kamas, pure ranching country
classification: Hyper-local community assembly — no commercial retail, no downtown
vibe: Pure, quiet ranching country. Places like Peoa feature spectacular river valleys and single-family properties on massive acreage, but have strictly zero commercial retail or downtown stores.
market_detail: The communities here run the bi-weekly Oakley Farmers Market (hosted at the nearby Oakley Rodeo Grounds) and the monthly Kamas Valley Market. It functions purely as a hyper-local community assembly rather than a commercial tourist trap. Local ranchers sell grass-fed meats directly to neighbors, local backyard growers bring seasonal mountain produce, and the Summit County Arts Council frequently sets up free live acoustic.

seasonal_local.name: Oakley Farmers Market
seasonal_local.flavor: Grass-fed meats from ranch neighbors, backyard mountain produce, river valley greens
seasonal_local.pancake_tip: Grab grass-fed breakfast sausage from a Peoa rancher, crumble into Kodiak savory waffle batter with aged cheddar — ranch hands' breakfast, keep it hearty for fencing at dawn.

seasonal_local.pancake_tip: Fold diced mountain greens and early peas into batter with a dash of cream — Kamas backyard to griddle.
